live_measurement.claim_policy: precision and recall require complete attributed live-model results

owner_resolution.current_owner_rule: prepend the resolved current owner before transition bridging; if that creates Nomia-to-Magia, insert Mago rather than emitting or failing on the forbidden direct edge
owner_resolution.router_authority: read-only; selects current owner and handoff sequence but never writes domain artifacts
owner_resolution.same_owner_phase_rule: consecutive intents owned by the same skill coalesce into one owner phase while ordered intents remain preserved; an owner repeated after another owner remains a repeated phase
